stories.headline: Beware higher correlation but nab high U.S. credit yields, fund managers say
stories.body: The AI boom could trigger a recession, but data centers remain an attractive investment opportunity, a hedge fund manager said.

stories.headline: Indian Shares Little Changed In Cautious Trade
stories.body: (RTTNews) - Indian shares were flat to slightly higher in cautious trade on Thursday after rising sharply in the previous session.

stories.headline: WaFd-Everbank merger secures early approvals
stories.body: The pending merger of Seattle-based WaFd and EverBank Financial in Florida has secured two regulatory approvals, BBVA is ramping up its US expansion with the creation of a repo and securities financing business, UBS Group suffered a further defeat in the long-running Swiss capital debate, and more in this week's banking news roundup.
